Enabled.Name: Skip Automated Animations when BLFX animates
Enabled.Hint: When Boss Loot FX is going to animate an item, effect or condition, Automated Animations doesn't play its own animation for it.

MatchMode.Name: What counts as a duplicate
MatchMode.Hint: Same activity: Automated Animations is skipped if BLFX animates the activity at any moment (attack, damage, use, template, summon). Same moment only: it is skipped only if BLFX animates that exact moment, so an Automated Animations damage animation still plays when BLFX only animates the attack. Effects are always compared with BLFX effect animations.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write every skipped and allowed Automated Animations animation to the browser console.
